# c4-from-yaml

> Generate C4 context, container and component diagrams in Mermaid syntax from one validated YAML architecture model with safe loading Python package `trysac-c4-from-yaml`, import name `c4_from_yaml`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
